newsitem.title: USA: American Express Credit Saison to issue card.
newsitem.headline: American Express Credit Saison to issue card.

text.p: Credit Saison Co Ltd, and American Express Co said Monday that they have agreed to launch a new Saison American Express Card.
The new card, said American Express, is targeted to young affluent Japanese customers and will be available later this year.
American Express said it is the company's first network agreement in Japan and represents an extension of its global strategy of opening its merchant network to other card issuers.
It also said that the new card represents a key strategic alliance for Credit Saison, and is intended to increase that company's customer base and strenghten its brand.
In the past 18 months American Express has agreed to issue cards through banks in Ireland, Central America, Turkey and Israel, it said.
Saison is a financial services subsidiary of the Saison Group, an issuer of 15 million proprietary and co-branded credit and charge cards in Japan.
